backend/main.mo: Stores and manages MappingInfo records, allowing adding entries, deleting by timestamp range, and fetching the first or all records.
feature_evidence.json: Defines feature evidence metadata linking feature IDs to affected files, components, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries for multiple frontend files describing their roles in the Techify landing page and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Provides prerequisite tools and initial steps for deploying the Techify landing page to the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and extensive OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell that mounts the React app and loads the main TypeScript entry file.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Initializes React Query and renders the TechifyLandingPage inside a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/constants/techify.ts: Exports centralized constants for contact info, WhatsApp messaging, pricing, and a list of Canva Pro features.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, recreating it when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity provider and hook for authentication, identity persistence, and login state management.
frontend/src/hooks/useLivePurchases.ts: Placeholder file with no implementation provided.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Minimal stub noting that feature-specific hooks are used instead of centralized queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useRecordPurchaseEven: Placeholder file with no implementation provided.
frontend/src/hooks/useSimulatedLivePurch: Generates client-side simulated purchase activity with random buyer names, periodic increments, timestamp aging, and recent activity tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpiPayment.ts: Provides a hook to trigger UPI deep-link payments with a mobile check, fallback UI, and clipboard copy support.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers, theme CSS variables, dark mode values, and custom gradient and focus utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider, loading global styles.
frontend/src/pages/TechifyLandingPage.ts: Implements the full Techify marketing landing page with pricing, WhatsApp links, UPI payment flow, and simulated scarcity.
frontend/src/utils/clipboard.ts: Exports a clipboard helper that attempts modern copy first and falls back to a legacy execCommand method.
frontend/src/utils/upi.ts: Generates UPI deep links and WhatsApp URLs using TECHIFY constants for payments and support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with extended color tokens, animations, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Tracks project state, requirements, known issues, and architectural notes for the Techify landing page.
